title: Sydney 2017: archived call for presentations
body:
Archived deadline notice

The following wording is preserved from the historical submission page. It is not an invitation to submit a proposal today.

CALL FOR PRESENTATIONS IS OPEN UNTIL July 14, 2017 at 11:59PM Pacific Time (July 15, 2017 at 6:59 UTC)

The former application let speakers manage their own submissions. Submission, editing and deletion actions are closed in this archive.

Browse the Sydney 2017 archive
description: Historical Sydney 2017 guidance. Submissions, voting and review actions are closed.
archiveNotice: Historical Sydney 2017 archive. All submission, voting and review actions for this page are closed. Instructions and deadlines below are retained only for reference.
